# kener_incident_comment (Resource)

Manages a status update (comment) on a Kener incident.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kener_incident_comment" "update" {
  incident_id = kener_incident.outage.id
  comment     = "We have identified the root cause."
  state       = "IDENTIFIED"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `comment` (String) Comment body.
- `incident_id` (String) Id of the incident this comment belongs to. Changing it forces recreation.
- `state` (String) Incident state at this update. One of `INVESTIGATING`, `IDENTIFIED`, `MONITORING`, `RESOLVED`.

### Optional

- `timestamp` (Number) Comment time as a Unix timestamp (seconds). Defaults to the time of creation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the comment.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Incident comments are imported by "incident_id:comment_id".
terraform import kener_incident_comment.update 42:7
```
